For vacation bills — bakes the full next-term amount for these extra fees straight into the regular bill (e.g. Excursion Fee), so parents pay one consolidated bill instead of a separate extra-fee bill.
Saved together with the "Save Info" button below.
Sends a simple daily report (today's payments, new admissions, money still owed by fee type, classes owing) to the Proprietor Report Email and/or Phone Number every day at 4:00 PM (school closing time).
A Drive folder for student photos is created automatically the first time anyone uploads a photo — you don't need to do anything here. Photos are kept viewable via link for portal rendering.

How to process a payment notification:
1. Check your Mobile Money account for the Reference ID shown
2. Verify the amount matches what the parent entered
3. Click ✅ Confirm to mark as confirmed, then manually update the student's record in the relevant term page
4. Click ❌ Reject if the reference is invalid or amount doesn't match

School Fees Management System

A comprehensive web application for managing school fees, tracking payments, generating bills, and communicating with parents.

✨ Key Features
Multi-term fee management (First, Second, Third Term)
Student records with installment tracking
Bill and receipt generation with printing
WhatsApp fee reminders to parents
Bulk SMS via Arkesel gateway
Parent Portal with payment notifications
Dashboard with analytics charts
Import/Export records (Excel & CSV)
Customizable fee components & classes
Activity logging & student status tracking

Module / Feature Admin Collector
V  A  E  D		 Viewer
V  A  E  D
Legend: V = View · A = Add/Record · E = Edit/Collect · D = Delete. Admin always has full access. Collector/Viewer checkboxes control sidebar visibility for every module; Add/Edit/Delete are additionally enforced on the Inventory & Sales modules (POS/Sell, Inventory, Stock Transactions, Vendors), Income & Expenses, and Salaries.

Built with ❤️ using Google Apps Script
